node.title: Re^3: Lost in DateTime !
node.author: pcouderc
node.doctext: Thank you all monks for your help. I think that , thanks to you, I have found a full DateTime solution : my $Date3= $Date->clone()->set_time_zone('floating')->set_time_zone( 'UTC' )->set_time_zone( 'Europe/Paris' ); That is, remove Paris time zone code, by converting to floating, set UTC time code, then convert by setting Paris time code.
